rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something unlikely to be true or to happen.

example.english: It is improbable that this deal will succeed.
example.traditional: 呢單交易唔大可能成功。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 gaau1 jik6 m4 daai6 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when saying that an event or action probably will not happen.

example.english: With rain this heavy, it is improbable that the outdoor event will go ahead as planned.
example.traditional: 落咁大雨，個戶外活動都唔似會照常舉行。
example.jyutping: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 go3 wu6 ngoi6 wut6 dung6 dou1 m4 ci5 wui5 ziu3 soeng4 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Use this when judging that a claim or explanation is probably not true.

example.english: What he said about never meeting that person is improbable.
example.traditional: 佢話自己從來冇見過嗰個人，唔似係真。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 cung4 loi4 mou5 gin3 gwo3 go2 go3 jan4 m4 ci5 hai6 zan1
